  • Method Details

    • beforeRetry

      boolean beforeRetry(int attempt, ProcessAutomation automation, ReplayStepRecord record)
      Prepares a retry, for example by perturbing an initial guess or loosening a controller.
      Parameters:
      attempt - retry number, starting at 1
      automation - automation facade of the model that will be re-run
      record - record of the current step (inputs already applied)
      Returns:
      true to retry, false to give up on this step
